paragraphs: I'm Bamzolin, a self-taught graphic designer working under Bamzolin Labs. My approach is rooted in intentional visual storytelling — bold, high-contrast compositions that carry emotional weight, whether I'm building a brand identity, an app icon, or a campaign visual. Alongside design, I bring a Mechanical Engineering background into my process, which shows up as precision in the details: grid systems, geometry, and production specs that hold up at any scale.

My work spans branding and visual identity for platforms like PrymeKids, an educational space for children, as well as personal and community projects that lean into symbolism and narrative depth. I care about the story behind every project as much as the final output — every color, shape, and layout choice is made to serve something bigger. Bamzolin Labs is where that philosophy lives: a space where design meets purpose.

contract.heading: Client Service Agreement
contract.intro: Welcome! Before we kick off your design project, please review these straightforward terms. By checking the agreement box or paying your project invoice, you agree to the following workflow.
paragraphs: Welcome to our creative partnership, where clear communication and mutual trust guide every design project to ensure a smooth, collaborative experience. Work officially begins upon receipt of a 60% deposit at the commission of the project, which secures your spot on the calendar and covers initial research and setup. Your invoice outlines the exact deliverables included in your package, and every standard project features up to two rounds of revisions to refine the work to your satisfaction, with any additional scope quoted separately prior to starting. The remaining 40% balance is due upon project completion, right before final high-resolution assets and source files are released.

Once your final payment is cleared, full copyright ownership for the approved designs transfers entirely to you, while we retain the right to showcase the completed work in our portfolio unless a non-disclosure agreement is in place. Because the 60% initial deposit covers reserved time and preliminary work, it is non-refundable, though you will receive all draft files completed up to that point if you decide to cancel. If an unexpected emergency forces us to cancel the project on our end, any unearned portion of your funds will be promptly refunded. Checking the agreement box on this website or paying your initial invoice serves as your electronic signature to officially begin.
